rules.alternatives: Keep an anchor RN license (Missouri or multistate) and national certification current; the APRN license expires at the earlier of the RN license or national certification expiration. Send recertification evidence to the board.
rules.notes: No APRN CE hours stated. APRNs with a Missouri RN license pay no separate APRN fee; those with another state's multistate RN license renew Feb 1 - Apr 30 of odd-numbered years.
